answer: Forging a thousand wallets costs a thousand stakes, so flooding the grove of peers with fakes drains real capital. Sybil resistance comes from staking at the wharf: each agent locks collateral before joining, and identities are weighted by bonded value, not count. Slashed bonds from misbehavior feed a shared reserve, a glacier of slowly accrued trust that only honest uptime can melt into rewards, making mass reputation slot cheap to claim but ruinously expensive to sustain. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
